lead: Tall Buddha head for terrariums in a dark gray old-stone look, with spiral curls covering the head and a calm face with closed eyes.
imageAlt: Tall dark gray Buddha head with spiral curls - NS Reptiles

description.html: The tall Buddha head shows the whole head with the neck, as if taken from a large statue. The hair is rendered as dense spiral curls covering the entire crown, there is a small dot on the forehead, and the face is calm, with lowered eyelids and a gentle smile. The dark gray, strongly textured surface resembles stone that has stood outdoors for a long time.

Thanks to its height, it is a good choice for the back or side of the terrarium, where it creates a vertical accent and adds depth to the setup. It looks great surrounded by plants, roots and moss, like a statue overgrown by the jungle, as well as in calm, minimalist setups with sand and stones. If you need a lower decoration for the foreground, take a look at the low version of the Buddha head.

Tall objects can tip over if an animal pushes them or digs underneath. That is why you should place the head on a firm, flat surface, preferably directly on the terrarium floor, and then add substrate around it. To clean it, take it out, rinse it with lukewarm water without detergent and clean the hollows between the curls with a soft brush, then dry it before putting it back.
